entry.dropTitle: Drop check-up reports and medical records here
entry.dropHint: Text PDFs, such as reports exported from a hospital or check-up system. You can add several at once. Scans and photos need text recognition, which this version does not do yet; you can use Paste text instead.
entry.dropHint_ocr: PDF (text or scanned) and photos (JPG, PNG, HEIC). You can add several at once.
entry.whyMany: Why add several at once? The same person gets the same code in every file, so the AI can compare results across years.
entry.local: Reading the text and finding personal information both happen on this computer.
entry.local_ocr: Reading the text and finding personal information both happen on this computer.
entry.spreadsheet: Need to clean personal information out of a spreadsheet (.xlsx, .csv)?
entry.pastePlaceholder: Paste the text of a medical record or report here
entry.notReady: The local engine is not ready yet. Please try again in a few seconds.
entry.roundActive: This round is not finished; its code list is still here.
entry.confirmNew: Starting over clears this round's files and code list. My info is kept.

myInfo.title: My info
myInfo.intro: Add yourself and your family. These details are found and replaced directly, with no guessing. Stored only on this computer.
myInfo.name: Name
myInfo.tip: Thirty seconds of typing beats letting an AI guess.
myInfo.memoryOnly: No secure storage on this computer, so this is kept only until you quit

reading.title: Reading {{count}} files
reading.local: Reading happens on this computer, offline.
reading.local_ocr: Text recognition runs on this computer, offline.
reading.errorStays: Files with errors stay in the list with the page and the reason. Nothing jumps away on its own.
reading.continueSkipping: Skip the parts with errors and continue
reading.noText: No text was found in these files. Scans and photos need text recognition, which this version does not do yet. Use a text PDF, or Paste text.
reading.noText_ocr: No text was found in these files. If a scan is blurry, try a clearer photo, or use Paste text.

errors.unreadable: The file cannot be opened or is damaged

errors.unsupported: This kind of file is not supported yet

errors.timeout: Reading took too long; the rest was not read

errors.too_large: The image is too large. Please make it smaller first.
errors.stopped: Reading was stopped before this file was finished

errors.needs_ocr: Scanned or photographed content needs text recognition, which this version does not do yet

failures.unsupported_platform_ocr: Reading PDFs and photos currently works on macOS only. You can use Paste text instead.

failures.too_many_files: Up to 50 files at a time. Please split them into several rounds.

reading.stopping: Stopping. Files already read are kept…

review.title: Found {{count}} pieces of personal information
review.summary: {{sure}} are certain and handled as suggested · {{pending}} need your eyes
review.summaryDone: {{sure}} are certain and handled as suggested · you have checked the rest
review.noneHint: The rules found no names, ID numbers or phone numbers. Please still read the original on the right.
review.pending: {{count}} uncertain items are not checked yet and will follow the suggestion. You can come back and change them.
review.pending_one: 1 uncertain item is not checked yet and will follow the suggestion. You can come back and change it.
review.copyBlocked: Originals remain, so copying is blocked. Handle them one by one on the next step, Share.

share.title: Shareable version
share.codesHint: Codes are shown in green and copy as plain text
share.residueOkHint: None of these remain: values already replaced, anything from My info, and numbers the rules can identify. Names and addresses the rules did not mark are not part of this check, so please read the original once more.
share.residueBadHint: These are still in the shareable version. Copy and save stay off until they are handled.

residueKinds.replaced_value: Already replaced elsewhere, but appears here
residueKinds.unreviewed: Looks like a {{category}} that was not handled

share.how1: Paste it into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any other AI.
share.how2: Use the codes in your questions too, for example: "How did {{code}}'s cholesterol change over two years?"
share.how3: Keep the codes; restoring the answer needs them.
share.tableTitle: The code list stays on this computer
share.tableHint: The code list is gone when you quit CellSentry, so keep it open until you restore the answer.
share.changed: The shareable version changed after you copied or saved it. Copy it again if you give the new version to the AI.
share.fillMyInfo: Fill in My info so your and your family's names and addresses are found directly.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. If the text is very long, save it as a file instead.
share.copyBlocked: Originals remain. Copying is blocked until they are handled.

restore.title: Paste the AI's answer here
restore.placeholder: Paste the AI's answer; it is restored automatically
restore.unknown: The answer contains codes we never issued: {{codes}}. They are left as they are; the AI may have made them up, so please check.
restore.local: Restoring happens only on this computer and is not sent anywhere.
restore.empty: After you paste an answer, the restored version appears here.
restore.startOverConfirm: This clears this round's files and code list. My info is kept. Continue?
restore.changed: You changed the shareable version after copying it. The answer is restored with the version you copied last; if you gave the new version to the AI, go back and copy it first.
restore.notShared: You have not copied or saved the shareable version yet, so the current codes are used.
restore.clipboard: Copying puts the restored answer on the system clipboard, where clipboard history tools and Universal Clipboard may keep it.
restore.toggleHint: Click a marked spot to switch between the original and the code.
restore.ambiguous_one: 1 spot reads like an ordinary word, so it was not restored. It has a dashed outline; click it if it is a code.
restore.ambiguous: {{count}} spots read like ordinary words, so they were not restored. They have a dashed outline; click one if it is a code.
restore.canonical: Restoring uses the spelling saved in the code list. Differences in spaces or quotes for the same address are not preserved exactly; a street-only mention may become the full address.
